controls.label: unclaimed-writable
failedAssertions: excludes writable elmdb/1 handles from physical recovery until close
excludes writable sqlite/1 handles from physical recovery until close

controls.label: quarantine-without-exclusion
failedAssertions: refuses elmdb/1 history quarantine while a managed reader still holds the directory
refuses sqlite/1 history quarantine while a managed reader still holds the directory

controls.label: io-classified-unreadable
failedAssertions: never treats SQLITE_IOERR_READ as permission to replace a SQLite history directory

controls.label: forget-uncertain-open
failedAssertions: retains the directory claim when a failed SQLite constructor could not close its connection

controls.label: ignore-directory-identity
failedAssertions: excludes physical directory identity even when its claim uses another leaf spelling

controls.label: quarantine-stale-incumbent
failedAssertions: refuses stale elmdb/1 history publication after another directory was installed
refuses stale sqlite/1 history publication after another directory was installed

controls.label: omit-native-close-uncertainty
failedAssertions: retains the directory claim when a failed SQLite constructor could not close its connection
